messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the 1767 incident postmortem — rolling up action items and owners. Can each owner ack and confirm due dates? TL;DR: we need infra changes, monitoring, and runbook updates. Action list:

- HEN-101: Add circuit-breaker to model-routing (owner: Henry) — due 2026-01-12
- SRE-77: Add alert for KV-cache eviction spike (owner: Sasha) — due 2026-01-08
- PLAT-22: Update canary rollback doc + automate smoke checks (owner: Lucy) — due 2026-01-15
- ONCALL-5: Postmortem review + runbook drill (owner: Maya) — due 2026-01-10
- ENG-OPS: Verify dedicated pool autoscale limits (owner: Raj) — due 2026-01-14

Please ack or reassign. I'll track and ping every 3 days. @henry @sasha @lucy @raj

Henry: Ack — I'm on HEN-101. Quick note: need model-variants team to sign off on compatibility matrix. Can @carlos own that signoff?

Carlos: can do, but I need the matrix exported from infra by EOD today. @infra-bot can you generate the compat matrix?

infra-bot: Generating model_compat_matrix.csv — https://redwood.s3/archives/model_compat_matrix.csv :white_check_mark:

Sasha: Ack SRE-77. I'll push the alert rule tomorrow AM. If eviction spikes are noisy we'll quarantine by host group first.

Lucy: PLAT-22 — I can take the doc but need a slot from Eng QA to wire the smoke tests. @emma can you help?

Emma: I can pick this up next sprint, but need the smoke test spec. @lucy can you paste the checks you want?

Lucy: Paste:
```
- smoke step 1: healthcheck on /v1/health
- step 2: run 100 qps against canary model for 60s
- step 3: verify latency p95 < 200ms and error rate < 0.5%
```

Raj: ENG-OPS — I need access to dedicated pool configs (team: eng-platform). @henry please grant workspace infra-role. Also asking for historical autoscale graphs.

Henry: Granted Raj infra-role. Historical graphs: https://grafana.redwood/d/auto/scale_history?panelId=7

Maya: I'll run the first runbook drill on 2026-01-09 16:00 PST — will invite SRE + Oncall. If anyone can't make that time propose alternatives.

Sasha: good for me

Carlos: can do

Emma: tentative, might be in sprint planning — prefer 2026-01-10 10:00 PST if possible

Maya: noted — moving drill to 2026-01-10 10:00 PST. Final action: everyone post a quick 1-line status update in this thread when your ticket moves to 'in review' or 'done'. I'll close the loop after all done. :100:

Henry: Will post when PR is up (HEN-101)

Sasha: alert rule created and tested in staging — SRE-77 -> in review

Lucy: doc drafted, awaiting QA slot — PLAT-22 -> in progress

Raj: autoscale limits verified, PR opened -> ENG-OPS -> in review

Maya: Thanks — added checklist to the incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1767/actions

oncall-ops: Reminder: scheduled maintenance on 2026-01-11 might affect canary pools. Coordinate with PLAT if smoke tests during that window.

Lucy: noted, will avoid that window

Carlos: compat matrix looks clean, I signed off HEN-101 dependency

Henry: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/542 — running CI

infra-bot: CI passed for PR #542 :tada:

Henry: PR merged, HEN-101 -> done

Maya: All owners reported status. I'll mark actions complete once all tickets are closed. Good work team. :raised_hands:
